sources.entry: Software for submission of abstracts and preparation/management of academic conferences.

summary.name: Abstract management
summary.one_liner: Wikipedia article describing abstract management, the process of accepting and preparing conference abstracts, and the web-based software used to automate it.
use_cases: organizing an academic conference's abstract submissions
assigning abstracts to oral or poster sessions
tracking continuing medical education credit at specialty society meetings
summary.what_it_does: The page explains that abstract management means accepting and preparing abstracts for academic conference presentation, covering invited or proffered submissions, peer review, acceptance or rejection by a chair or committee, and allocation to sessions. It describes how abstracts may be presented orally or as posters and later published as proceedings or in journals. It also outlines how conference management systems are web-based software that help program chairs, organizers, authors and reviewers, and are comparable to domain-specific content management systems. The article notes the shift from manual paper-based handling to web-based tools and lists categories of solutions, including standalone abstract management systems, conference management platforms and open-source solutions, though it does not name specific products in the text provided.
notable: Explains the peer review workflow for conference abstracts and full papers
Describes conference management systems as domain-specific content management systems
Links abstract management to continuing medical education credits
caveats: Article is incomplete and flagged as needing more citations
The text provided does not name specific software products or their pricing
